name: KYC record opened (proposed)
description: PROPOSED: nothing publishes to this queue yet and its listener does not trigger Novu. Tells the subject of a KYC record (applicant, or organisation contact) that a record was opened and what to do next. Only non-sensitive fields: no identity numbers, screening results or risk ratings.
publishers: none yet: proposed in KycRecordServiceImpl after a new record is saved

recipientName.description: Person, or organisation contact, the record is about

reference.description: KYC record reference shown to the user

organisationName.description: Requesting organisation, when there is one

steps.name: kyc-record-in-app
steps.subject: KYC record {{payload.reference}} opened
steps.body: {% if payload.organisationName %}{{payload.organisationName}} has opened{% else %}We have opened{% endif %} KYC record {{payload.reference}} for you. Status: {{payload.status | default: 'in progress'}}.

steps.name: kyc-record-email
steps.subject: Your KYC record {{payload.reference}} has been opened
